name: Vaudemanges
terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
There is no legal or agreed definition of old, so the words promise nothing on their own.
Most Champagne is non-vintage, a blend of several years for a steady house style. In great years a house may declare a vintage and bottle wine from that harvest alone.
Made only from white grapes. In Champagne that usually means 100% Chardonnay.
White wine made only from black grapes. In Champagne, Pinot Noir, Meunier or both.
How sweet a sparkling wine is after dosage: Extra Brut under 6 g of sugar a liter, Brut under 12, Demi-sec 32 to 50. Brut is the most common.

blurb.text: A cru village inside Champagne. Allowed grapes include Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Meunier, plus Pinot Blanc, Pinot Gris, Petit Meslier and Arbane.
